'''Anna Ceresole''' (born 1961) is an Italian high energy physicist and Director of Research in Theoretical Physics at the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] (INFN). She is interested in [[quantum field theory]], [[supergravity]] and [[string theory]].

== Early life and education ==
Ceresole was born in [[Turin]] and studied at the [[University of Turin]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://superfields.web.cern.ch/Superfields/team_members/anna.html|title=SUPERFIELDS|website=superfields.web.cern.ch|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref> Her thesis considered [[Kaluza–Klein theory]] and supergravity, which resulted in published work with Pietro Fré and [[Hermann Nicolai]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=KoFuDwAAQBAJ&dq=ceresole+anna+infn&pg=PA280|title=A Conceptual History of Space and Symmetry|last=Fré|first=Pietro Giuseppe|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3-319-98023-2|language=en|year=2018}}</ref> She earned her PhD at the [[Stony Brook University|State University of New York at Stony Brook]] in 1989, working with [[Peter van Nieuwenhuizen]].<ref name=":0" /> Here she was a [[Fulbright Program]] Fellow.<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Ceresole joined [[California Institute of Technology]] in 1989, working as a postdoctoral fellow.<ref name=":0" /> She was appointed as a research fellow at the [[University of Turin]] in 1992.<ref name=":0" /> In 1998 she joined [[CERN]] as a visiting scientist. She was made research professor at the [[Polytechnic University of Turin]] in 2003.<ref name=":0" /> In 2004 she described a superpotential that supported a class of stable extremal black holes.<ref name="Ceresole 2007 110">{{Cite journal|last1=Ceresole|first1=Anna|last2=Dall'Agata|first2=Gianguido|date=2007|title=Flow equations for non-BPS extremal black holes|url=http://inis.iaea.org/Search/search.aspx?orig_q=RN:38081489|journal=Journal of High Energy Physics|language=English|volume=3|issue=2007|page=110|doi=10.1088/1126-6708/2007/03/110|issn=1126-6708|bibcode=2007JHEP...03..110C|arxiv=hep-th/0702088|s2cid=2678928}}</ref> She works on special [[Kähler manifold]] geometry and [[black hole]] solutions in supergravity.<ref name=":2">{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=qMJNDwAAQBAJ&dq=ceresole+anna+infn&pg=PA267|title=Advances in Geometry and Lie Algebras from Supergravity|last=Frè|first=Pietro Giuseppe|date=2018-02-24|publisher=Springer|isbn=978-3-319-74491-9|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Ceresole|first1=Anna|last2=Ferrara|first2=Sergio|last3=Gnecchi|first3=Alessandra|last4=Marrani|first4=Alessio|date=2009-08-20|title=More on <math>\mathcal{N}=8</math> attractors|journal=Physical Review D|volume=80|issue=4|article-number=045020|doi=10.1103/PhysRevD.80.045020|arxiv=0904.4506 |bibcode=2009PhRvD..80d5020C |s2cid=119196015|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/1174799|type=Submitted manuscript}}</ref>

She was a team member of the [[European Research Council]] Advanced Investigator Grant, ''Supersymmetry, Quantum Gravity and Gauge Fields.''<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://superfields.web.cern.ch/Superfields/team.html|title=SUPERFIELDS|website=superfields.web.cern.ch|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref> She was a working group leader for the [[European Cooperation in Science and Technology]] ''String Theory Universe'' COST action.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cost.eu/COST_Actions/mpns/MP1210?management|title=COST {{!}} The String Theory Universe - Management Committee|website=www.cost.eu|language=en|access-date=2018-10-06|archive-date=2018-10-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181006194640/http://www.cost.eu/COST_Actions/mpns/MP1210?management}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cost.eu/about_cost/who/(type)/5/(wid)/35198|title=COST {{!}} Who's Who|website=www.cost.eu|language=en|access-date=2018-10-06|archive-date=2018-10-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181006195003/http://www.cost.eu/about_cost/who/(type)/5/(wid)/35198}}</ref>

In 2015 she was appointed as the coordinator of the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] Theory Group in Torino.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.strings.to.infn.it/personal/ceresole/|title=Anna Ceresole|website=www.strings.to.infn.it|language=en|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref> Since 2017 she is part of the Management Committee of the Arnold Regge Centre for Algebra, Geometry and Theoretical Physics, a collaboration between the [[University of Turin]] and [[University of Eastern Piedmont]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.arnoldreggecenter.com/inaugural-conference-of-the-arnold-regge-center-for-algebra-geometry-and-theoretical-physics/|title=Inaugural Conference of the Arnold-Regge Center {{!}} ARNOLD REGGE CENTER|website=www.arnoldreggecenter.com|date=19 October 2017 |language=en-US|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref> She has been Scientific Advisor for several international string theory conferences.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.strings13.unibe.ch/participants.html|title=Strings13|website=www.strings13.unibe.ch|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://indico.mpp.mpg.de/event/1040/registration/registrants?sessionShowNoValue=1&order=up&sortBy=City|title=STRINGS 2012 (23-28 July 2012)|website=indico.mpp.mpg.de|access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref> She has contributed to many important textbooks on geometry and supergravity.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nk7qoBnVt7gC&dq=ceresole+anna+infn&pg=PA494|title=Search for the "totally Unexpected" in the LHC Era: Proceedings of the International School of Subnuclear Physics|last=Zichichi|first=Antonino|date=2010|publisher=World Scientific|isbn=978-981-4293-24-2|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://indico.in2p3.fr/event/12356/|title=2nd Workshop on String Theory and Gender (9-10 June 2016) · IN2P3 Events Directory (Indico)|website=IN2P3 Events Directory (Indico)|date=9 June 2016 |access-date=2018-10-06}}</ref>
